n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (Every window in the house turns white at once.)

n2.speaker: momo
n2.text: The gate is not opening near us. It is opening around us.

n3.speaker: player
n3.text: (The walls groan. Beyond the glass, the street is gone—replaced by Ilyr's dead eastern watch, suspended in a sky without stars.)

n5.speaker: player
n5.text: (At the center of the ruin stands a figure crowned in black antlers. Eleven empty suits of Warden armor kneel around it.)

n7.speaker: player
n7.text: (The front door tears from its hinges. Faelen steps into the breach before the splinters touch the floor.)

n9.speaker: player
n9.text: (The antlered figure lowers its weapon. The empty Wardens rise in perfect silence.)

n10.speaker: faelen
n10.text: It remembers my command. It will use them to hold me while it crosses.

n12.speaker: faelen
n12.text: You once ordered me to retreat with the formation. I am about to disobey you.

n13.speaker: faelen
n13.text: You trusted my call and asked me to leave you something to carry. I am giving you everything.

n14.speaker: faelen
n14.text: Kess, break the right flank. Momo, call the false movements. Thora, keep the doorway standing.

n16.speaker: player
n16.text: (The old formation charges. Faelen does not meet it like a wall. She opens her guard and lets the strength of the whole house move through it.)

n17.speaker: player
n17.text: (Kess's strike becomes Faelen's turn. Momo's warning becomes her parry. Thora's shield becomes the ground beneath her feet. Your blade finds the seam.)

n19.speaker: player
n19.text: (Eleven empty helms turn toward her. For one impossible heartbeat, they stand at her side. Then they drive their spears into the antlered figure.)

n20.speaker: player
n20.text: (The gate shatters. The house slams back into its own street. Dawn pours through the missing door.)

n21.speaker: faelen
n21.text: Tirren. Sava. Pell. All of you... dismissed.

n22.speaker: player
n22.text: (The last points of Warden light disappear. Faelen bows her head, but she remains standing.)

n23.speaker: faelen
n23.text: My oath ended with them. I have spent three years pretending it did not, because I did not know who I was without it.

one1.speaker: faelen
one1.text: Then I will fight as one of you—not ahead, and never alone.

home2.speaker: player
home2.text: (She says it like a vow she chose for herself.)

converge.speaker: thora
converge.text: A beautiful revelation. Now, who is helping me replace that door?

n25.speaker: kess
n25.text: Faelen broke it with her dramatic character development. Faelen buys the door.

n27.speaker: player
n27.text: (For once, she sits at the table with her back to the open doorway.)
